Method of Attack: Zero-click security vulnerabilities exploiting memory consumption leading to heap corruption (CVE-2020-9819) and out-of-bounds write causing unexpected memory modification or application termination (CVE-2020-9818) triggered by processing maliciously crafted mail messages
Attack Vector: Maliciously crafted email messages processed by the default Mail app
Indicators of Compromise: In-the-wild triggers on a few organizations targeting high-profile users
